title: Persistent Unveils €81 Per Share Bid for Nagarro, Eyeing AI Engineering Dominance
summary: Persistent has announced its intention to acquire Nagarro through a voluntary public takeover offer of €81 per share. This all-cash deal, offering a substantial premium, is designed to merge the two entities into the Persistent-Nagarro Group, a new global leader in AI-led digital engineering.
content:
In a move set to send ripples across the technology landscape, Persistent has unveiled its intention to launch a voluntary public takeover offer for all outstanding shares of Nagarro. The proposed all-cash deal, valued at a compelling €81 per share, represents a staggering premium of approximately 140% over Nagarro's undisturbed closing price on June 25, 2026 – a clear signal of Persistent's aggressive pursuit of market leadership. This strategic maneuver isn't just about expansion; it's a bold declaration of intent to forge the "Persistent - Nagarro Group" into a global powerhouse in AI-led digital engineering.

The ambition behind this acquisition is palpable. By combining Persistent's extensive digital engineering prowess and global footprint with Nagarro's specialized capabilities and agile delivery models, the merged entity aims to deliver unparalleled value in an increasingly AI-driven world. As businesses worldwide accelerate their digital transformation journeys, the demand for sophisticated, AI-infused engineering solutions is exploding. This combination is designed to meet that demand head-on, leveraging enhanced talent pools and broader industry expertise to innovate faster and serve a more diverse clientele.

For Nagarro shareholders, the offer is undeniably attractive. An €81 per share all-cash payout delivers a significant premium, reflecting the strategic value Persistent sees in Nagarro's innovative spirit, skilled workforce, and established client relationships. It's a testament to Nagarro's growth trajectory and a lucrative exit for investors. The merger promises to unlock new synergies, creating a formidable force capable of shaping the future of digital product development and intelligent enterprise solutions.

This isn't merely a transaction; it's a strategic realignment intended to propel both companies to the forefront of the digital engineering revolution. The Persistent-Nagarro Group is poised to become a dominant player, equipped to tackle the complex challenges of tomorrow's technological landscape, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in AI and digital innovation.
keyTakeaways: Persistent is launching an all-cash takeover offer for Nagarro at €81 per share.
The offer includes a substantial premium of approximately 140% over Nagarro's undisturbed closing price on June 25, 2026.
The acquisition aims to form the Persistent-Nagarro Group, positioning it as a global leader in AI-led digital engineering.
author: Staff Writer
